segments.title: 1,009 pages in a DEAD shorthand
segments.say: Kurt Gödel left over a thousand pages in a dead shorthand.

segments.title: Written in Gabelsberger
segments.say: Sixteen notebooks from the nineteen-forties, in an obsolete shorthand.

segments.title: Humans: about 1 page a week
segments.say: Humans managed a page a week. Then a researcher tried an AI, Claude.

segments.title: AI: a digest in days
segments.say: In days: six hundred sixty-three results. About four hundred held up. Two hundred needed fixes. Fifty were false.

segments.sub: A human checked every page. Trust AI with history?
segments.say: A human still checked every page. Would you trust AI with history? Comment below.
